title: aspidium hornei
intro: Aspidium hornei, commonly known as Lady fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Aspleniaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lady fern include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and act as an expectorant, making it useful in treating respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of Aspidium hornei include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
